text: A formula of the form Q₁x₁ Q₂x₂ … Qₙxₙ ψ, where each Qᵢ is a quantifier and ψ is quantifier-free (the matrix), is said to be in ___ normal form.
explanation: This is prenex normal form: all quantifiers pulled to the front, followed by a quantifier-free matrix. Every first-order formula has a logically equivalent prenex form, and prenex form is the starting point for Skolemization.
